verdict.rationale: YPOG is a law and tax advisory firm, so user-configurable event-triggered automation rules are a category error for this kind of offering. Its software-supported transparency-register service (YSolutions) and its general 'digital workflows and AI-based systems' boilerplate describe internal service delivery, not a rules engine that clients can configure.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can define rules that trigger actions automatically on events
